mapper.select: SELECT t.housework_task_id , t.household_id , t.housework_id , t.name AS housework_name , t.description , t.category , t.target_date , t.assignee_user_id , hm.nickname AS assignee_nickname , t.status , t.assign_reason_type , t.done_at , t.skipped_reason FROM t_housework_task t LEFT JOIN m_household_member hm ON hm.household_id = t.household_id AND hm.user_id = t.assignee_user_id WHERE t.household_id = #{householdId} AND t.status = #{status} AND t.target_date >= #{lowerDate} ORDER BY t.target_date ASC, t.housework_task_id ASC
